raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# PR type
- [x] New Feature
- [x] Document Updates
- [x] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information
Add an Ascend LoRA training example for StartLux decision checkpoints using SWIFT's existing Qwen3.5 dense/MoE loaders and trainer. The example preserves the official prompt renderer, trains soft cross-entropy over legal candidate letters at the last prompt position, and freezes the original backbone, vision tower and vocabulary head. It exports ordinary PEFT adapters rather than a new model architecture.

Attention LoRA is the default; an optional language-linear scope also covers supported feed-forward projections while excluding vision and the vocabulary head.

The paired evaluator reloads an adapter, disables it for the baseline, verifies case-level split separation and scores original hard labels. The README includes the container, dependency pins, train/resume commands and the distinction between domain accuracy and seven-suite accuracy. FSDP validation runs after model and optimizer preparation.

## Experiment results
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests/trainers -p "test_startlux*.py" -v`: 8 CPU tests passed, including structured JSON evidence, language-linear LoRA isolation and a real two-process FSDP2 checkpoint regression.
- Changed-file `pre-commit` checks passed.
- Real StartLux-4B on Ascend: forward/backward, finite loss and gradient norms, optimizer updates, adapter save and full checkpoint state restore were exercised. An independent paired validation pass reloads the exported adapter.
- StartLux-35B-A3B: four-device FSDP completed real forward/backward, finite updates and checkpoint save. Two 64-GB devices cannot hold the current NPU FP32 master-weight preparation.
- The recipe uses sharded FSDP2 training checkpoints and a separate full PEFT inference export. The original pinned full-state adapter save/restore path fails the two-process numerical regression; sharded save/reload passes it. A two-device 4B NPU audit exactly matched all 304 restored adapter tensors before the next update. Continued training is not claimed bitwise equivalent; corrected 35B checkpoint-format validation remains pending. Old full-state checkpoints are rejected for FSDP resume.
- No seven-suite accuracy improvement is claimed. Fine-tuning quality remains a separate held-out evaluation gate; private records and experiment measurements are not included here.

# Checklist
- [x] Relevant local tests and reproduction scope are described above.
- [ ] Human review and acceptance of all changed lines.

@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+# StartLux decision LoRA training on Ascend
+
+This example fine-tunes the language backbone of an existing StartLux decision checkpoint. It preserves the official prompt renderer and optimizes soft cross-entropy over legal answer letters. It does not append the target answer to the input, train the vision tower, or turn decisions into a text-generation SFT task.
+
+| Item | Recipe |
+| --- | --- |
+| Framework | SWIFT; existing Qwen3.5 dense/MoE loading and NPU kernels |
+| Checkpoints | StartLux-Decision-4B and StartLux-Decision-35B-A3B |
+| Trainable weights | Rank 16 / alpha 32 / dropout 0.05; default attention LoRA, optional `--lora-scope language-linear` for all supported language-backbone linear layers |
+| Frozen weights | Original backbone weights, vision, embeddings and vocabulary projection |
+| Objective | Per-question soft cross-entropy at the last real prompt token; only legal candidates enter softmax |
+| Numerical head | 26 letter rows projected in FP32; original frozen weight/name retained for PEFT compatibility |
+| Scope | Text only, 2–26 candidates per question; unsupported wide choices/images fail explicitly |
+| Output | PEFT adapter and full training-state checkpoint; not a merged standalone checkpoint |
+
+## Environment
+
+Use a new container. The reproduction image is pinned below; exporting the image is unnecessary. Replace all paths, container name and assigned physical NPU IDs. The driver must be installed on the host.
+
+```bash
+export IMAGE=quay.nju.edu.cn/ascend/ms-swift@sha256:d1b56f2d77882edb92615c45641556c8d5adaf8ed360be73f4f0978f70fa01c1
+export CONTAINER='<NEW_CONTAINER_NAME>'
+export TASK_ROOT='<ABSOLUTE_TASK_DIRECTORY>'
+export MODEL_ROOT='<ABSOLUTE_CHECKPOINT_PARENT>'
+export DATA_ROOT='<ABSOLUTE_DATA_DIRECTORY>'
+export NPU_IDS='<ASSIGNED_PHYSICAL_NPU_IDS>'
+mkdir -p "$TASK_ROOT"
+git clone --branch startlux_decision_npu_training \
+  https://github.com/Liuchenbing-2026/ms-swift.git "$TASK_ROOT/framework"
+docker pull "$IMAGE"
+readarray -td, CARDS <<<"$NPU_IDS,"
+DEVICES=()
+for card in "${CARDS[@]}"; do
+  [[ "$card" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && DEVICES+=(--device "/dev/davinci$card")
+done
+docker run -d --name "$CONTAINER" --network host --shm-size 16g \
+  "${DEVICES[@]}" --device /dev/davinci_manager --device /dev/devmm_svm --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
+  -e ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$NPU_IDS" \
+  -v "$TASK_ROOT:/workspace" -v "$MODEL_ROOT:/models:ro" -v "$DATA_ROOT:/data:ro" \
+  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \
+  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info:ro \
+  -v "$(command -v npu-smi):/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro" "$IMAGE" sleep infinity
+docker exec -it "$CONTAINER" bash
+```
+
+The training checkout is mounted at `/workspace/framework`. Inside the container, prepare the official protocol source and Python environment:
+
+```bash
+cd /workspace
+source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
+git clone https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/StartLux-Decision.git source
+git -C source checkout 0e7a2e81b9c92756e26d8edd843a44d50e362669
+python -m venv --system-site-packages .venv
+export PATH=/workspace/.venv/bin:$PATH
+export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/framework:/workspace/source${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}
+export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4
+python -m pip install --no-deps peft==0.20.0 numpy==1.26.4
+python -m pip install --no-deps -e /workspace/framework
+```
+
+The tested stack uses CANN 9.1.0, PyTorch 2.10.0, torch-npu 2.10.0.post2, Transformers 5.15.1, Accelerate 1.14.0 and datasets 4.8.4. SWIFT uses PEFT 0.20.0 and NumPy 1.26.4.
+The image includes NPU FLA support. Do not install CUDA FLA/causal-conv1d wheels over it. Keep CANN's Python paths when prepending the source checkout.
+
+The original checkpoint directories must include the tokenizer and `decision_config.json`. Published references are `StartLuxAI/StartLux-Decision-4B` at `9113683823edce9311109fff84cf9719394835d8` and `StartLuxAI/StartLux-Decision-35B-A3B` at `e6dafa13615ba6858e9489416216a9b46c36e45c` on ModelScope. Download them to the host model directory before creating the read-only model mount.
+
+## Data
+
+Supply JSONL cases with `state`, `questions` and `targets`. State may be a text string or structured JSON business evidence; the official renderer serializes it. Image/video blocks and their reserved media keys are rejected. Candidate order is preserved by the official renderer. Each target is a distribution over the original option IDs. Values are finite, nonnegative and normalized by the loader. The optional `gold` field is mandatory for independent accuracy evaluation and contains the original hard label, which may differ from a tie-broken soft-target argmax.
+
+```json
+{"state":"A duplicate charge is visible on the receipt.","questions":{"route":{"type":"choice","instructions":"Choose the team.","criteria":{"billing":null,"shipping":null}}},"targets":{"route":{"billing":0.95,"shipping":0.05}},"gold":{"route":"billing"}}
+```
+
+Use the official `from_systemone` schema for `noul` (IDs `true`/`false`) and `score` (IDs `0`–`5`). Keep train, validation, calibration and test cases disjoint **before** flattening their questions. The scripts reject duplicate cases and train/evaluation overlap. They do not construct or relabel your dataset. Calibration/test records must not be training or checkpoint-selection inputs.
+
+## Train and resume
+
+Run from the example directory. Use a fresh output directory for each experiment. Start with a short run, inspect finite loss/gradients and saved weights, then run the actual domain fine-tuning experiment.
+
+```bash
+cd /workspace/framework/examples/train/startlux_decision
+python train.py --model /models/StartLux-Decision-4B \
+  --train /data/train.jsonl --dev /data/validation.jsonl \
+  --steps 120 --batch-size 2 --accum 4 --lr 2e-5 \
+  --output /workspace/results/4b-run1
+
+# Four-device MoE run. MASTER_PORT must be free on this host.
+OMP_NUM_THREADS=16 python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc-per-node 4 \
+  --master-addr 127.0.0.1 --master-port 29613 train.py \
+  --model /models/StartLux-Decision-35B-A3B \
+  --train /data/train.jsonl --dev /data/validation.jsonl \
+  --steps 120 --batch-size 1 --accum 4 --lr 2e-5 \
+  --output /workspace/results/35b-run1 --fsdp
+```
+
+For SWIFT, effective global batch is batch size × accumulation × data-parallel world size; FSDP shards parameters across the four ranks. The current NPU FSDP preparation uses FP32 master weights, so two 64-GB devices are insufficient for 35B; start with four devices and adequate host RAM for CPU loading.
+Resume using the **complete training checkpoint**, not the adapter-only export. FSDP2 uses distributed `SHARDED_STATE_DICT` model and optimizer checkpoints. The final `adapter/` directory is exported separately as full PEFT weights for inference. Older full-state FSDP2 adapter checkpoints are rejected: the pinned dependency path only restored rank-zero adapter shards. Do not resume those old checkpoints as if they preserved every rank. Keep model, data, batch/accumulation and process layout unchanged; resume from an intermediate checkpoint with the original total-step and scheduler configuration:
+
+```bash
+python train.py --model /models/StartLux-Decision-4B \
+  --train /data/train.jsonl --dev /data/validation.jsonl \
+  --steps 120 --batch-size 2 --accum 4 --lr 2e-5 \
+  --resume /workspace/results/4b-run1/checkpoint-50 \
+  --output /workspace/results/4b-resumed
+```
+
+The optional `--lora-scope language-linear` follows the official fine-tuning scope for supported linear modules, including dense/shared feed-forward projections. It excludes vision and the vocabulary head. Fused MoE expert parameter tensors are not ordinary linear modules and are not selected. Keep the scope unchanged when resuming.
+
+A short smoke run checks execution, not model quality. `validation.json` records pre/post loss, arguments and the trainable-parameter audit. Original fitted temperatures do not remain validated after an adapter changes weights.
+
+## Independent comparison
+
+`evaluate.py` reloads the saved adapter and compares it with the same checkpoint with the adapter disabled, using identical prompts. It requires hard labels and rejects overlap with training cases. Report absolute correct/total and the paired accuracy delta; retain regressions as well as improvements.
+
+```bash
+python evaluate.py --model /models/StartLux-Decision-4B \
+  --adapter /workspace/results/4b-run1/adapter \
+  --train /data/train.jsonl --data /data/test-gold.jsonl \
+  --output /workspace/results/4b-test-paired
+
+cd /workspace/framework
+python -m unittest discover -s tests/trainers -p 'test_startlux*.py' -v
+```
+
+Outputs contain per-question predictions, checkpoint/data hashes, correct/total and mean soft CE. This domain score is **not** the unweighted average of the official seven suites. Evaluate those suites separately using their official prompts, score aggregation and fixed checkpoint. Do not claim a general benchmark gain based on training loss or a small domain test. Before probability-based routing, fit a new temperature on a disjoint calibration split and verify it on held-out data.
+
+## Validation status
+
+Both real 4B and 35B checkpoints have completed forward/backward, finite optimizer updates and checkpoint save on Ascend. The 35B run used four devices. The original SWIFT 35B full-state resume completed execution but failed numerical restoration. A two-process reproducer confirmed that nonzero-rank adapter state was not restored. The recipe now uses sharded training checkpoints; CPU collective save/reload restores the adapter exactly. A two-device 4B NPU audit also matched all 304 restored adapter tensors exactly before the next update. Continuing training completed with finite weights but was not bitwise identical to the uninterrupted run. The corrected checkpoint format has not yet been revalidated on the full 35B model.
+
+The included CPU tests cover candidate-only FP32 projection, causal readout, target masking, structured text input, train/evaluation overlap, original hard labels and LoRA exclusion of vision/output weights. These tests and short hardware runs establish execution contracts; independent accuracy gains and seven-suite acceptance remain experimental. No seven-suite improvement is claimed.

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+"""Shared StartLux training contract: official prompts and candidate-only soft CE."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import torch
+from pathlib import Path
+from torch import nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+
+FSDP_STATE_DICT_TYPE = 'SHARDED_STATE_DICT'
+
+
+class CandidateHead(nn.Module):
+    """Keep the original checkpoint weight/name; project legal letters in FP32."""
+
+    def __init__(self, head, letter_ids):
+        super().__init__()
+        if head.bias is not None or len(set(letter_ids)) != 26:
+            raise ValueError('Expected a bias-free head and 26 distinct letters')
+        self.weight = head.weight
+        self.weight.requires_grad_(False)
+        self.register_buffer('letter_ids', torch.tensor(letter_ids), persistent=False)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden):
+        with torch.autocast(hidden.device.type, enabled=False):
+            weight = self.weight.index_select(0, self.letter_ids.to(self.weight.device))
+            return F.linear(hidden.float(), weight.float())
+
+
+def install_head(model, checkpoint, tokenizer):
+    from startlux_decision import jevfmt
+    config = json.loads((Path(checkpoint) / 'decision_config.json').read_text())
+    letters = jevfmt.check_tokenizer(tokenizer)
+    if letters != config['letter_token_ids']:
+        raise ValueError('Checkpoint and tokenizer letters differ')
+    model.set_output_embeddings(CandidateHead(model.get_output_embeddings(), letters))
+    model.config.use_cache = False
+    if hasattr(model.config, 'text_config'):
+        model.config.text_config.use_cache = False
+
+
+def contains_media(value):
+    """Reject media blocks without rejecting ordinary JSON business evidence."""
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        media_keys = {'image', 'image_url', 'video', 'video_url', 'images', 'videos'}
+        return (bool(media_keys.intersection(value))
+                or value.get('type') in ('image', 'image_url', 'video', 'video_url')
+                or any(contains_media(item) for item in value.values()))
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return any(contains_media(item) for item in value)
+    return False
+
+
+def encode_records(path, tokenizer, max_length=8192, with_gold=False):
+    from startlux_decision import jevfmt
+    features, identities = [], set()
+    for line_number, text in enumerate(Path(path).read_text().splitlines(), 1):
+        if not text.strip():
+            continue
+        record = json.loads(text)
+        if record.get('images') or record.get('videos') or contains_media(record['state']):
+            raise ValueError('This training recipe is text-only')
+        identity = hashlib.sha256(
+            json.dumps([record['state'], record['questions']], sort_keys=True,
+                       ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
+        if identity in identities:
+            raise ValueError(f'Duplicate case at {path}:{line_number}')
+        identities.add(identity)
+        if set(record['targets']) - set(record['questions']):
+            raise ValueError('Target references an unknown question')
+        for key, question in record['questions'].items():
+            if key not in record['targets']:
+                continue
+            row = jevfmt.from_systemone(record['state'], question, qid=key)
+            order = [option['id'] for option in row['options']]
+            if not 2 <= len(order) <= 26:
+                raise ValueError('Split wide choices before training; no silent filtering')
+            target = record['targets'][key]
+            if set(target) - set(order):
+                raise ValueError('Target references an unknown option')
+            values = [float(target.get(option, 0)) for option in order]
+            if any(not math.isfinite(v) or v < 0 for v in values) or math.fsum(values) <= 0:
+                raise ValueError('Targets must have finite nonnegative mass')
+            ids, rendered_order = jevfmt.render_ids(row, tokenizer, order, max_length=max_length)
+            if rendered_order != order:
+                raise ValueError('Renderer changed candidate order')
+            features.append({
+                'input_ids': ids,
+                'labels': [v / math.fsum(values) for v in values] + [-1.] * (26 - len(values))
+            })
+            if with_gold:
+                gold = str(record['gold'][key])
+                if gold not in order:
+                    raise ValueError('Gold label is not a legal candidate')
+                features[-1]['gold'] = order.index(gold)
+                features[-1]['case_id'] = identity
+                features[-1]['question_id'] = key
+    if not features:
+        raise ValueError('No supervised questions')
+    return features, identities
+
+
+def collate(features, pad_token_id):
+    length = max(len(row['input_ids']) for row in features)
+    ids = torch.full((len(features), length), pad_token_id, dtype=torch.long)
+    mask = torch.zeros_like(ids)
+    for i, row in enumerate(features):
+        size = len(row['input_ids'])
+        ids[i, :size] = torch.tensor(row['input_ids'])
+        mask[i, :size] = 1
+    return {
+        'input_ids': ids,
+        'attention_mask': mask,
+        'labels': torch.tensor([r['labels'] for r in features], dtype=torch.float32),
+        'use_cache': False
+    }
+
+
+def candidate_loss(logits, attention_mask, targets):
+    if logits.ndim != 3 or logits.shape[-1] != 26:
+        raise ValueError('Expected [batch, sequence, 26] candidate logits')
+    positions = attention_mask.sum(-1) - 1
+    selected = logits[torch.arange(logits.shape[0], device=logits.device), positions].float()
+    valid = targets >= 0
+    log_probs = F.log_softmax(selected.masked_fill(~valid, -torch.inf), -1).masked_fill(~valid, 0)
+    return -(targets.clamp_min(0) * log_probs).sum(-1)
+
+
+def lora_targets(model, scope):
+    if scope == 'attention':
+        return [
+            'q_proj', 'k_proj', 'v_proj', 'o_proj', 'in_proj_qkv', 'in_proj_z', 'in_proj_b', 'in_proj_a', 'out_proj'
+        ]
+    if scope != 'language-linear':
+        raise ValueError(f'Unknown LoRA scope: {scope}')
+    body = model.model.language_model
+    targets = [
+        'model.language_model.' + name for name, module in body.named_modules()
+        if name and isinstance(module, torch.nn.Linear)
+    ]
+    if not targets:
+        raise ValueError('No supported linear modules in the language backbone')
+    return targets
+
+
+def audit_splits(train, validation):
+    overlap = train & validation
+    if overlap:
+        raise ValueError(f'Train/validation overlap: {len(overlap)} cases')
+
+
+def copy_metadata(checkpoint, output):
+    """Retain tokenizer/protocol; old fitted temperatures require recalibration."""
+    import shutil
+    output = Path(output)
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for name in [
+            'decision_config.json', 'chat_template.jinja', 'preprocessor_config.json', 'processor_config.json',
+            'tokenizer_config.json', 'tokenizer.json'
+    ]:
+        source = Path(checkpoint) / name
+        if source.exists() and not (output / name).exists():
+            shutil.copy2(source, output / name)
+
+
+def audit_trainable(model):
+    names = {name: parameter.numel() for name, parameter in model.named_parameters() if parameter.requires_grad}
+    if not names or any('lora_' not in name or 'visual' in name or 'lm_head' in name for name in names):
+        raise ValueError('Only language-backbone LoRA parameters may be trainable')
+    return {'parameters': sum(names.values()), 'tensors': names}

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+"""Compare an adapter with its original checkpoint on disjoint labeled cases."""
+import argparse
+import contextlib
+import hashlib
+import json
+import torch
+from decision_training import audit_splits, candidate_loss, collate, encode_records, install_head
+from pathlib import Path
+from peft import PeftModel
+from transformers import AutoConfig
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--model', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--adapter', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--data', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--train', required=True, help='Used only to reject overlapping cases')
+    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output = Path(args.output)
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(args.model)
+    from swift.model import get_model_processor
+    model_type = 'qwen3_5_moe' if 'Moe' in config.architectures[0] else 'qwen3_5'
+    model, processor = get_model_processor(
+        args.model, model_type=model_type, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map='auto', attn_impl='sdpa')
+    tokenizer = getattr(processor, 'tokenizer', processor)
+    install_head(model, args.model, tokenizer)
+    rows, identities = encode_records(args.data, tokenizer, with_gold=True)
+    _, train_ids = encode_records(args.train, tokenizer)
+    audit_splits(train_ids, identities)
+    model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(model, args.adapter).eval()
+    device = model.get_input_embeddings().weight.device
+    totals = {mode: {'correct': 0, 'total': 0, 'loss_sum': 0.} for mode in ('base', 'adapter')}
+    with torch.inference_mode(), (output / 'predictions.jsonl').open('w') as stream:
+        for index, row in enumerate(rows):
+            batch = collate([row], tokenizer.pad_token_id)
+            targets = batch.pop('labels').to(device)
+            batch = {
+                key: value.to(device) if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) else value
+                for key, value in batch.items()
+            }
+            record = {'case_id': row['case_id'], 'question_id': row['question_id'], 'gold': row['gold']}
+            for mode in totals:
+                context = model.disable_adapter() if mode == 'base' else contextlib.nullcontext()
+                with context:
+                    logits = model(**batch).logits
+                loss = candidate_loss(logits, batch['attention_mask'], targets).item()
+                selected = logits[0, -1].float().masked_fill(targets[0] < 0, -torch.inf)
+                if not torch.isfinite(selected[targets[0] >= 0]).all():
+                    raise RuntimeError('Non-finite candidate logits')
+                prediction = int(selected.argmax())
+                totals[mode]['correct'] += prediction == row['gold']
+                totals[mode]['total'] += 1
+                totals[mode]['loss_sum'] += loss

+        result['accuracy'] = result['correct'] / result['total']

+        vars(args),
+        'scope':
+        'Hard-label decision accuracy; not seven-suite macro accuracy. '
+        'Probabilities use T=1; re-fit calibration on a separate calibration split.'
+    }
+    (output / 'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(report['results']), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+import argparse
+import json

+from decision_training import (FSDP_STATE_DICT_TYPE, audit_splits, audit_trainable, candidate_loss, collate,
+                               copy_metadata, encode_records, install_head, lora_targets)

+from transformers import AutoConfig
+from transformers.trainer_callback import TrainerCallback
+
+from swift.model import get_model_processor
+from swift.template import get_template
+from swift.trainers import Seq2SeqTrainer, Seq2SeqTrainingArguments

+
+class DecisionTrainer(Seq2SeqTrainer):
+
+    def _get_data_collator(self, args, template):
+        from functools import partial
+        return partial(collate, pad_token_id=template.tokenizer.pad_token_id)
+
+    def compute_loss(self, model, inputs, return_outputs=False, num_items_in_batch=None):
+        inputs = dict(inputs)
+        targets = inputs.pop('labels')
+        inputs.pop('compute_loss_func', None)
+        outputs = model(**inputs)
+        loss = candidate_loss(outputs.logits, inputs['attention_mask'], targets).mean()
+        return (loss, outputs) if return_outputs else loss
+
+
+class BeforeValidation(TrainerCallback):
+    """Validate after Trainer has prepared the FSDP model and optimizer together."""
+
+    def __init__(self, trainer):
+        self.trainer = trainer
+        self.metrics = None
+
+    def on_train_begin(self, args, state, control, **kwargs):
+        self.metrics = self.trainer.evaluate()
+        return control
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--model', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--train', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--dev', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--save-steps', type=int, default=50)
+    parser.add_argument('--steps', type=int, default=120)
+    parser.add_argument('--batch-size', type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument('--accum', type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument('--lr', type=float, default=1e-4)
+    parser.add_argument('--lora-scope', choices=['attention', 'language-linear'], default='attention')
+    parser.add_argument('--resume')
+    parser.add_argument('--fsdp', action='store_true')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if Path(args.output).exists() and not args.resume:
+        raise FileExistsError('Use a fresh output directory')
+    if args.fsdp and args.resume:
+        for name in ('pytorch_model_fsdp_0', 'optimizer_0'):
+            if not (Path(args.resume) / name / '.metadata').is_file():
+                raise ValueError("FSDP resume requires this recipe's sharded model and optimizer checkpoint")
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(args.model)

+    dev, dev_ids = encode_records(args.dev, tokenizer)
+    audit_splits(train_ids, dev_ids)
+    template = get_template(processor, template_type='qwen3_5', padding_free=False, padding_side='right')
+    template.model = model
+    model = get_peft_model(
+        model, LoraConfig(r=16, lora_alpha=32, lora_dropout=0.05, target_modules=lora_targets(model, args.lora_scope)))
+    audit = audit_trainable(model)
+    extra = {}
+    if args.fsdp:
+        extra = {
+            'fsdp': 'full_shard auto_wrap',
+            'fsdp_config': {
+                'state_dict_type':
+                FSDP_STATE_DICT_TYPE,
+                'fsdp_version':
+                2,
+                'transformer_layer_cls_to_wrap':
+                sorted({type(m).__name__
+                        for m in model.modules() if type(m).__name__.endswith('DecoderLayer')}),
+                'activation_checkpointing':
+                True,
+                'use_orig_params':
+                True
+            }
+        }
+    training = Seq2SeqTrainingArguments(
+        output_dir=args.output,
+        max_steps=args.steps,
+        per_device_train_batch_size=args.batch_size,
+        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.batch_size,
+        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.accum,
+        learning_rate=args.lr,
+        bf16=True,
+        gradient_checkpointing=not args.fsdp,
+        gradient_checkpointing_kwargs={'use_reentrant': False},
+        use_logits_to_keep=False,
+        remove_unused_columns=False,
+        dataloader_num_workers=0,
+        dataloader_pin_memory=False,
+        save_steps=min(args.save_steps, args.steps),
+        save_total_limit=2,
+        logging_steps=1,
+        eval_strategy='no',
+        report_to=[],
+        seed=42,
+        data_seed=42,
+        check_model=False,
+        **extra)
+    trainer = DecisionTrainer(
+        model=model,
+        args=training,
+        template=template,
+        train_dataset=Dataset.from_list(train),
+        eval_dataset=Dataset.from_list(dev))
+    trainer.model_accepts_loss_kwargs = False
+    baseline = BeforeValidation(trainer)
+    trainer.add_callback(baseline)
+    trainer.train(resume_from_checkpoint=args.resume)
+    after = trainer.evaluate()
+    if args.fsdp:
+        # Full adapter export is for inference; resumable training states remain sharded.
+        plugin = trainer.accelerator.state.fsdp_plugin
+        plugin.state_dict_config = None
+        plugin.optim_state_dict_config = None
+        plugin.set_state_dict_type('FULL_STATE_DICT')
+    trainer.save_model(str(Path(args.output) / 'adapter'))
+    if trainer.is_world_process_zero():
+        copy_metadata(args.model, Path(args.output) / 'adapter')
+        Path(args.output, 'validation.json').write_text(
+            json.dumps(
+                {
+                    'before': baseline.metrics,
+                    'after': after,
+                    'train_questions': len(train),
+                    'dev_questions': len(dev),
+                    'steps': trainer.state.global_step,
+                    'training_args': vars(args),
+                    'trainable': audit,
+                    'scope': 'held-out validation loss; test accuracy must be evaluated separately'
+                },
+                indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+class DecisionContract(unittest.TestCase):

+    def test_candidate_head_matches_fp32_reference_and_freezes_weight(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(4)
+        head = torch.nn.Linear(8, 64, bias=False).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        ids = list(range(1, 53, 2))
+        candidate = CandidateHead(head, ids)
+        x = torch.randn(2, 5, 8, dtype=torch.bfloat16, requires_grad=True)
+        actual = candidate(x)
+        expected = x.float() @ head.weight[ids].float().T
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        actual.square().mean().backward()
+        self.assertIsNone(head.weight.grad)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(x.grad).all())
+        self.assertEqual(set(candidate.state_dict()), {'weight'})
+
+    def test_soft_loss_uses_last_real_token_and_only_legal_candidates(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(3)
+        logits = torch.randn(2, 5, 26, requires_grad=True)
+        mask = torch.tensor([[1, 1, 0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]])
+        targets = torch.full((2, 26), -1.)
+        targets[0, :2] = torch.tensor([.3, .7])
+        targets[1, :3] = torch.tensor([0., .4, .6])
+        loss = candidate_loss(logits, mask, targets)
+        expected = torch.stack([
+            -(targets[0, :2] * logits[0, 1, :2].log_softmax(-1)).sum(),
+            -(targets[1, :3] * logits[1, 4, :3].log_softmax(-1)).sum()
+        ])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(loss, expected)
+        loss.mean().backward()
+        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(logits.grad).all())
+        self.assertEqual(logits.grad[0, 2:].abs().sum().item(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(logits.grad[:, :, 3:].abs().sum().item(), 0)
+
+    def test_collation_does_not_append_answer_tokens(self):

+    def test_language_linear_lora_does_not_train_vision_or_output_head(self):

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+"""Exercise the recipe's checkpoint format with real two-rank CPU FSDP2."""
+import importlib.util
+import os
+import socket
+import tempfile
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+
+def checkpoint_worker(rank, directory):
+    from accelerate.state import PartialState
+    from accelerate.utils.fsdp_utils import load_fsdp_model, save_fsdp_model
+    from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model
+    from torch.distributed.device_mesh import init_device_mesh
+    from torch.distributed.fsdp import (FullOptimStateDictConfig, FullStateDictConfig, ShardedOptimStateDictConfig,
+                                        ShardedStateDictConfig, StateDictType, fully_shard)
+
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    os.environ.update(
+        RANK=str(rank), LOCAL_RANK=str(rank), WORLD_SIZE='2', LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE='2', MASTER_ADDR='127.0.0.1')
+    loopback = next((name for _, name in socket.if_nameindex() if name in ('lo', 'lo0')), None)
+    if loopback:
+        os.environ['GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME'] = loopback
+    dist.init_process_group('gloo', init_method='file://' + directory + '/rendezvous', rank=rank, world_size=2)
+    try:
+        PartialState(cpu=True)
+        source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'examples/train/startlux_decision/decision_training.py'
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('decision_contract', source)
+        contract = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        spec.loader.exec_module(contract)
+        state_type = StateDictType[contract.FSDP_STATE_DICT_TYPE]
+        full = state_type == StateDictType.FULL_STATE_DICT
+        plugin = SimpleNamespace(
+            fsdp_version=2,
+            state_dict_type=state_type,
+            state_dict_config=FullStateDictConfig(offload_to_cpu=True, rank0_only=True)
+            if full else ShardedStateDictConfig(offload_to_cpu=True),
+            optim_state_dict_config=FullOptimStateDictConfig(offload_to_cpu=True, rank0_only=True)
+            if full else ShardedOptimStateDictConfig(offload_to_cpu=True),
+            sync_module_states=True)
+        accelerator = SimpleNamespace(
+            num_processes=2,
+            process_index=rank,
+            is_fsdp2=True,
+            is_main_process=rank == 0,
+            wait_for_everyone=dist.barrier)
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        model = torch.nn.Module()
+        model.proj = torch.nn.Linear(8, 8)
+        model = get_peft_model(model, LoraConfig(r=2, target_modules=['proj']))
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
+                if 'lora_B' in name:
+                    parameter.copy_(torch.arange(parameter.numel()).view_as(parameter) / 100)
+        expected = {name: parameter.detach().clone() for name, parameter in model.named_parameters() if 'lora_' in name}
+        mesh = init_device_mesh('cpu', (2, ))
+        fully_shard(model.base_model.model.proj, mesh=mesh)
+        fully_shard(model, mesh=mesh)
+        save_fsdp_model(plugin, accelerator, model, directory, adapter_only=True)
+        dist.barrier()
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
+                if 'lora_' in name:
+                    parameter.zero_()
+        load_fsdp_model(plugin, accelerator, model, directory, adapter_only=True)
+        for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
+            if name in expected:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(parameter.full_tensor(), expected[name], rtol=0, atol=0)
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+class DecisionCheckpoint(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_all_rank_adapter_weights_survive_checkpoint_roundtrip(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            mp.spawn(checkpoint_worker, args=(directory, ), nprocs=2, join=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
